scheme_name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T. And S.B.C. Girl Students Studying In 5th To 7th Standard
other_conditions: Studying in a government recognized school
Belonging to Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) or Special Backward Classes (SBC)
